title: Value of a Counted Month in TRICARE Prime Proration Credits
content:
**Schedule.** In a TRICARE Prime proration credit, each counted month of the credited installment is valued from that installment's own charge, according to its frequency.

| Credited installment | A counted month is credited at |
|---|---|
| a monthly installment | its whole charge |
| a quarterly installment | one third of its charge, rounded to the cent |
| otherwise (an annual installment) | one twelfth of its charge (divided by 12), rounded to the cent |

## Hypothetical charges

| Credited installment and charge | Value of a counted month |
|---|---|
| monthly, 32.51 | 32.51 |
| quarterly, 97.53 | 32.51 |
| quarterly, 100.00 | 33.33 |
| annual, 969.36 | 80.78 |

The value is read from the charge actually posted on the installment, whatever the tier's current fee.
